construction: Equal-weight baskets, rebalanced monthly, measured against the Hang Seng Index.
history_note: Available history comes from the hk_search cache. Pre-launch series use the basket's starting membership.
note: Curated HK theme baskets for monitoring rotation. Descriptive only, not a buy list.

hk_platform_tech.name: China Platform Megacaps
hk_platform_tech.etf_proxy_note: HS TECH ETF — closest proxy; the index also carries hardware names
hk_platform_tech.thesis: The consumer-internet platform megacaps split out of the China Tech umbrella — the names that share one re-rating factor (domestic consumption, AI application, southbound flow) and lead HK turns. Xiaomi rides here by behavior: it trades with the platform factor, not the hardware one.
hk_platform_tech.thesis_zh: 从中资科技伞篮拆出的消费互联网平台龙头 — 共享同一重估因子（内需、AI 应用、南向资金）并引领港股拐点的成员。小米按行为归入此篮：其走势跟随平台因子而非硬件因子。

members.rationale: NetEase — gaming + music; the #2 China game publisher
